118148.description:
PSY GROOVE returns to Dublin on Saturday, 19 September 2026 for a full night of psychedelic frequencies.

From the opening Progressive vibes to the late-night energy, expect 10 hours of music, movement and connection with local and international artists. The journey starts with progressive grooves, builds through Full-On, and goes deep into Night & Forest Psytrance.

🗓️ Saturday, 19 September 2026
📍 The Racket Space, Dublin
⏱️ 17:00 — 03:00
🌴 PSY GROOVE
